niche_preference_profile: Prefers calm, spacious, clearly structured interfaces with soft premium minimalism: light or muted surfaces, generous breathing room, strong headline hierarchy, cohesive sectioning, restrained trust/consent flows, and controls that feel explicit and intentional rather than cluttered or overly promotional.

criteria.description: Generous spacing, fewer competing elements, and calmer pacing with strong breathing room instead of dense stacked content.
Clear top-level headline and well-separated sections with an obvious reading order, rather than many similarly weighted blocks competing for attention.
A softer, calmer, more restrained visual treatment with muted contrast and less aggressive or promotional styling.
Single-purpose, distilled flows with fewer options and less decision friction, especially in consent/privacy or setup moments.
Controls that make choices feel deliberate and clearly expressed, such as segmented selectors or strongly defined active states instead of flatter generic toggles.
